final: WITH race_counts AS (SELECT r.raceId, c.country, COUNT(cr.constructorResultsId) AS entry_count, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId LEFT JOIN constructorResults AS cr ON cr.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country), above_average AS (SELECT * FROM race_counts WHERE entry_count > (SELECT AVG(entry_count) FROM race_counts)), cutoff AS (SELECT entry_count FROM above_average ORDER BY entry_count DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9) SELECT a.raceId, a.country, a.total_points, a.entry_count, a.entry_count - (SELECT AVG(entry_count) FROM race_counts) AS above_average FROM above_average AS a WHERE a.entry_count >= (SELECT entry_count FROM cutoff) ORDER BY above_average DESC
